public_rationale: The forecast is conditional, and the search did not establish its no-moat antecedent. Available concentration evidence cannot substitute for that condition. There is also no deadline, so observations below 90% would not establish that nobody will ever reach it. No qualifying early-resolution event was found.
limitations: The outcome is withheld because the antecedent is unknown, not because the forecast has failed.
Different market definitions could produce different share estimates.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If there is no moat, no AI company will capture 90% of the AI market.

statement.excerpt: If there is no moat, nobody is going to take 90% of the market.
statement.document_title: Why things will eventually fall apart

our_interpretation: The relevant market is the general-purpose generative AI model and service market discussed in the post.
The numerical threshold is at least 90% for one provider.
Market share must use a consistent denominator. Chatbot website visits, enterprise API spending and consumer adoption are different measures.
The absence of moats is a separate antecedent. Competitive fragmentation alone does not establish it.
No deadline is supplied. Continued fragmentation cannot settle a prediction that nobody will ever reach the threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Once the absence-of-moats condition is established, a completed relevant market history shows that no provider reached 90%. Ordinary interim observations below 90% cannot conclusively support this deadline-free forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A provider reaches at least 90% of the consistently defined relevant market after publication while the absence-of-moats condition is established.

evidence.explanation: This reports declining concentration in an earlier LLM inference dataset. It neither measures post-publication attainment of 90% in the whole relevant market nor establishes the no-moat antecedent.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Evidence establishing the absence of moats, a defensible market denominator, and a dated observation of one provider reaching at least 90% would permit contradiction. Interim shares below 90% would leave the forecast open.
